Net Change.tooltip: Specifies the net change in the account balance during the time period in the Date Filter field.

Period Name.tooltip: Specifies the name of the period that you want to view.

Period Start.tooltip: Specifies the starting date of the period that you want to view.

Balance Due (LCY).tooltip: Specifies the balance due, in local currency.

Profit (LCY).tooltip: Specifies the profit related to the customer, in local currency.

Sales (LCY).tooltip: Specifies the sales related to the customer, in local currency.

Purchases (LCY).tooltip: Specifies the purchases, in local currency.

Qty. in Transit.tooltip: Specifies the quantity of the items that are currently in transit.

Qty. on Asm. Comp. Lines.tooltip: Specifies how many units of the item are allocated to assembly component orders.

Qty. on Assembly Order.tooltip: Specifies how many units of the item are allocated to assembly orders, which is how many are listed on outstanding assembly order headers.

Qty. on Job Order.tooltip: Specifies how many units of the item are allocated to projects, meaning listed on outstanding project planning lines. The field is automatically updated based on the Remaining Qty. field in the Project Planning Lines window.

Qty. on Purch. Order.tooltip: Specifies how many units of the item are inbound on purchase orders, meaning listed on outstanding purchase order lines.

Qty. on Sales Order.tooltip: Specifies how many units of the item are allocated to sales orders, meaning listed on outstanding sales orders lines.

Qty. on Service Order.tooltip: Specifies how many units of the item are allocated to service orders, meaning listed on outstanding service order lines.

Scheduled Issue (Qty.).tooltip: Specifies the sum of items from planned production orders.

Scheduled Receipt (Qty.).tooltip: Specifies how many units of the item are scheduled for production orders. The program automatically calculates and updates the contents of the field, using the Remaining Quantity field on production order lines.

Trans. Ord. Receipt (Qty.).tooltip: Specifies the quantity of the items that remain to be received but are not yet shipped. The program calculates this quantity as the difference between the Quantity and the Quantity Shipped fields. It automatically updates the field each time you either update the Quantity or Quantity Shipped field.

Trans. Ord. Shipment (Qty.).tooltip: Specifies the quantity of the items that remains to be shipped. The program calculates this quantity as the difference between the Quantity and the Quantity Shipped fields. It automatically updates the field each time you either update the Quantity or Quantity Shipped field.

Credit Amount.tooltip: Specifies the credit amount for the period on the line.

Debit Amount.tooltip: Specifies the debit amount for the period on the line.

Net Change.tooltip: Specifies changes in the actual general ledger amount.

Period Name.tooltip: Specifies the name of the period shown in the line.

Period Start.tooltip: Specifies the start date of the period defined on the line for the bank account balance.

Cust. Balances Due.tooltip: Specifies the total amount your company is owed by customers. The program automatically calculates and updates the contents of the field, using entries in the Remaining Amt. (LCY) field in the Cust. Ledger Entry table.

Period Name.tooltip: Specifies the name of the period covered by the summary report of receivables for customers and payables for vendors.

Period Start.tooltip: Specifies the beginning of the period covered by the summary report of receivables for customers and payables for vendors.

Receivables-Payables.tooltip: Specifies expected payments from customers and to vendors. It does not include other transactions that affect liquidity or the liquid balance at the beginning of the period. Therefore, the amounts in the column do not represent the liquid balance at the close of the period.

Vendor Balances Due.tooltip: Specifies the total amount your company owes its vendors. The program automatically calculates and updates the contents of the field, using entries in the Remaining Amt. (LCY) field in the Vendor Ledger Entry table.

Availability After Quotes.tooltip: Specifies capacity, minus quantity on order (Project), minus quantity on service order, minus project quotes allocation.

Capacity.tooltip: Specifies the total capacity for the corresponding time period.

Job Quotes Allocation.tooltip: Specifies the amount of measuring units allocated to projects with the status quote.

Net Availability.tooltip: Specifies capacity, minus the quantity on order, minus the projects quotes allocation.

Period Start.tooltip: Specifies a series of dates according to the selected time interval.

Qty. on Order (Job).tooltip: Specifies the amount of measuring units allocated to projects with the status order.

Qty. on Service Order.tooltip: Specifies how many units of the item are allocated to service orders, meaning listed on outstanding service order lines.

Net Change (LCY).tooltip: Specifies the net value of entries in LCY for the period shown in the left column.

Cash Flow Manual Revenues.tooltip: Specifies amounts related to manual revenues.

Fixed Assets Disposal.tooltip: Specifies amounts related to fixed assets disposal.

G/L Budget.tooltip: Specifies amounts related to the general ledger budget.

Purchase Orders.tooltip: Specifies amounts related to purchase orders.

Sales Orders.tooltip: Specifies amounts related to sales orders.

Service Orders.tooltip: Specifies amounts related to service orders.

Posted Income.tooltip: Specifies the total income (in LCY) that has been posted to the general ledger for the service item in the periods specified in the Period Start field.

Prepaid Income.tooltip: Specifies the total income (in LCY) that has been posted to the prepaid account with regard to the service item in the periods specified in the Period Start field.

Resources Used.tooltip: Specifies the cost of spare parts used in the period shown in the Period Start field.

Discount Amount.tooltip: Specifies the amount of discount being applied for the line.

Posted Cost.tooltip: Specifies the cost of the service contract based on its service usage in the periods specified in the Period Start field.

Posted Income.tooltip: Specifies the total income (in LCY) that has been posted to the general ledger for the service contract in the periods specified in the Period Start field.

Prepaid Income.tooltip: Specifies the total income (in LCY) that has been posted to the prepaid account for the service contract in the periods specified in the Period Start field.

Profit %.tooltip: Specifies the profit percentage for the service contract in the periods specified in the Period Start field.

Allocated Qty..tooltip: Specifies the amount of capacity that is needed to produce a desired output in a given time period.

Availability After Orders.tooltip: Specifies the available capacity of this resource.

Bill-to Customer No..tooltip: Specifies the number of the customer who pays for the project task.

Contract (Invoiced Price).tooltip: Specifies, in the local currency, the total billable price for the project task that has been invoiced during the time period in the Posting Date Filter field.

Contract (Total Price).tooltip: Specifies, in the local currency, the total billable price for the project task during the time period in the Planning Date Filter field.

External Document No..tooltip: Specifies a document number that refers to the customer's or vendor's numbering system.

Remaining (Total Price).tooltip: Specifies the remaining total price (LCY) as the sum of prices from project planning lines associated with the project task. The calculation occurs when you have specified that there is a usage link between the project ledger and the project planning lines.

Schedule (Total Price).tooltip: Specifies, in local currency, the total budgeted price for the project task during the time period in the Planning Date Filter field.

Usage (Total Price).tooltip: Specifies, in the local currency, the total price of the usage of items, resources and general ledger expenses posted on the project task during the time period in the Posting Date Filter field.

Your Reference.tooltip: Specifies the customer's reference. The content will be printed on sales documents.

Schedule (Total Price).tooltip: Specifies the total of the budgeted prices for the project.

Usage (Total Price).tooltip: Specifies project usage in relation to total price up to the date of the last project WIP calculation.

Invoiced Cost Amount (LCY).tooltip: Specifies the amount of the unit costs that has been posted from the invoice or credit memo. The amount is calculated based on Quantity, Unit Cost, and Line Discount %.
